description: This file defines a Spring MVC Controller named ProductAttributeController, responsible for managing product attributes in an e-commerce admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting product attributes, as well as fetching attribute types. The controller interacts with various service layers, handles user authorization, and manages data exchange between the view and backend services.

classes.name: ProductAttributeController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling product attribute management in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayProductAttributes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list product attributes for a specific product, verifying permissions and product ownership.

methods.name: pageAttributes
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide a paginated list of product attributes in JSON format based on product ID.

methods.name: displayAttributeEdit
methods.description: Displays the edit page for a specific product attribute, identified by its ID.

methods.name: displayAttributeCreate
methods.description: Displays the create page for adding a new product attribute.

methods.name: displayAttribute
methods.description: Internal method to prepare data for attribute create/edit views.

methods.name: saveAttribute
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a product attribute, including validation and related entity creation.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a product attribute based on its ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: checkAttributeType
methods.description: Returns the type of a product option (attribute type) based on option ID.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set menu attribute context in the model for page rendering.
